note: The starter Patterns (D47). Rows are layers, bottom row first; cells are nodes: + out, 0 flat, - in. No cell flips straight from out to in between rows, so a step is at most one depth. Defaults are in bead widths and pass bead support on every preset (test/starters.test.js).
